name: Lotus's
notes: Reference mark for optical sizing: heavy geometric letterforms that fill the full viewBox height. The trailing apostrophe-s is brand yellow #F9BE00, which sits at roughly 1.5:1 against the pearl background — a neutral treatment must darken rather than fade it, or that half of the wordmark disappears.

name: BTS
notes: The only portrait mark in the set: a small BTS logotype above the blue/red interlocking rail device. The logotype is about 12% of the total height, so it will not be readable at row scale — treat this as a symbol and render the brand name in text alongside it. Scaled up to 1.3 to give the narrow column comparable presence.

name: AIS
notes: Green gradient swoosh above and behind the AIS logotype. The letters occupy only the lower ~52% of the viewBox, hence the scale-up. Fills are gradient-clipped, so the file keeps its clipPath and linearGradient defs (ids are prefixed ais-*). The lime swoosh (#bfdf19) is very light and needs a darkening neutral treatment, not opacity.

name: iBerry
notes: Genuine mark, but raster only — no vector version is published anywhere. Transparent PNG at 176x50, so keep the rendered height at or below ~25px to stay crisp on 2x displays. Ink fills the full bitmap with no internal padding. The wordmark is set lowercase ('iberry') and is the pre-2026 logotype; the group refreshed its identity in 2026 but has published no downloadable asset.

name: IHG
notes: Secondary horizontal lockup: the IHG monogram plus a stacked 'HOTELS & RESORTS' descriptor, so the file already spells out the brand name. By far the widest mark in the set, scaled down so it does not dominate the row. Solid #000000 throughout, and includes a small registered-trademark glyph that will go soft below ~28px.
